           Mech Royale Elite Strategy Panel Report
Research synthesis combining battle-royale game design, game psychology, CS2 bot architecture,
Valorant AI research, and Mech Royale rules.

Executive Thesis
Mech Royale is a placement-maximization problem. Because placement, not kills, determines
score, the optimal agent should maximize survival probability, information advantage, and endgame
positioning. Battle-royale research consistently shows placement-heavy scoring incentivizes
rotation, information gathering, and selective engagements.

Industry Evidence
CS2 bots use behavior trees and navigation reasoning. Valve documentation describes behavior
trees evaluated every tick and navigation-centric control. Valorant AI research from Riot/modl.ai
emphasizes efficient sensors and world-state reasoning rather than raw vision models.

Panel Recommendations
Strategy Panel: AI Architect, Game Designer, Battle Royale Analyst, Behavioral Psychologist,
Systems Engineer. Consensus: 1) Roof-first looting. 2) Threat heatmaps. 3) Probabilistic enemy
memory. 4) Avoid fair fights. 5) Third-party engagements. 6) Aggression only in top-4.

Bot Architecture
Perception -> World Model -> Belief State -> Utility Engine -> Action Layer. Track enemy
probabilities, sound events, zone forecast, cover map, supply drops, and rooftop value.

Utility Function
Score = 0.35 Survival + 0.20 Position + 0.15 Information + 0.15 Resources + 0.10 Zone Safety +
0.05 Combat Opportunity.

Opening Strategy
Claim elevated positions and rooftops. Loot safely. Build information. Avoid engagements unless
extremely favorable.

Midgame
Rotate early, avoid exposure, exploit sound cues, ambush supply drops, and punish weakened
opponents.

Endgame
Convert to position-first play. Cover, elevation, line of sight, and escape routes matter more than
damage output.

Prediction
Winning entries will likely be utility-based planners with belief states rather than pure RL aim bots.

CS2 behavior trees: Valve Developer Community and Source2 Wiki. Riot/modl.ai Human-like Bots
